questions: Does every member pay the same fixed amount each round, or can people pay different amounts, or pay in parts across several days?
Who decides which member collects each round, and should the system enforce a fixed order or just let you pick anyone who hasn't collected yet?
Do you run only one group, or several groups at the same time, and can a member belong to more than one group?
answers: No, record whatever each member actually paid; the pot is the total paid in for that round.
